digest.component_or_area: store git operations failure handling and retry logic
propositions: Git failure strings are currently classified at five disparate sites with inconsistent verdicts for identical text, requiring consolidation into a single registry keyed by operation type.
The synthetic rc-124 timeout result is constructed at four locations with no shared retry policy, leaving sync._union_merge and push_recovery without transient retry semantics.

The marker string 'cannot lock ref' must preserve three deliberately different verdicts (local retriable lock, lease-push non-mismatch, ref-cas held lock) and cannot be merged into one classification.
Marker strings and timeout construction must be guarded to remain in their designated owner modules only, verified by AST inspection and construction-site conjunction analysis.
Invalid-object failures (missing objects in DB) require distinct INVALID_OBJECT kind with index-rebuild-then-retry recovery, separate from terminal FATAL failures.
